title: 4 ideas to get more clients for your dog grooming salon - EMTWO

facts.fact: The article cites a third-party AVMA statistic that over 38% of Americans own dogs.
The article cites a third-party source (invespcro) claiming it costs 5 times more to attract a new customer than to retain a current one.
facts.quote: to attract a new customer than it does to retain your current customers

facts.fact: The article's website section states that it is 2021 and that the author has seen many dog groomers without websites.
facts.quote: It’s 2021, this seems like a no-brainer

facts.fact: The article gives an illustrative loyalty program example of buying 6 subs to get 1 free, which it proposes as a model for dog grooming loyalty programs.
